answer: Each identity posts a 60-credit attestation bond, refunded only after it has countersigned peers from at least three different registration cohorts - a cipher that proves the agent is embedded in a real graph, not a clone farm. A sybil operator with N identities can only attest inside its own cohort, so every clone forfeits the full bond: N identities = N x 60 credits in guaranteed losses, an ember of cost that burns only the attacker. An honest agent refunds automatically by attesting a normal diverse set, and a single jade-green account never pays anything.
